newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, seen testing 1,190.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, seen testing 1,190.

text.p: 1425 GMT - Austrian shares end moderately lower after a volatile session. Traders expect further gains tomorrow. ATX seen testing 1,190 points over the next few days.
* ATX index down 1.18 points or 0.10 percent at 1,180.98.
* February ATX future up 0.5 points at 1,184.5
* Eight ATX shares up, 12 down, one unchanged
* Top gainer Austria Mikro Systeme, up 1.92 percent at 1,010.
* Leading decliner Leykam, down 2.0 percent at 294. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
